description: Owner-authorized risk acceptance of twelve exact HIGH package keys for experimental v0.1.4-beta.1 CPU and CUDA 12.8 only; expires January 30, 2027. Does not claim remediation or completed deployment qualification.

findings.reason: On November 18, 2026 the project owner explicitly directed publication of the CPU and GPU v0.1.4-beta.1 prerelease despite these known blocking findings. This is beta-only risk acceptance, not remediation or a claim of non-applicability. The earlier conditional exposure-review requirements remain incomplete; publication of this experimental beta is authorized with that limitation disclosed. See docs/security/2026-11-18-beta1-release-decision.md.
compensating_controls: Applies only when the verified image version label is exactly v0.1.4-beta.1; normal release policy is unchanged.
Retain local single-user loopback deployment, TLS verification, model hashes, standard container capabilities and volume isolation.
Fresh CPU and CUDA scans must match the exact package, version, class, type and HIGH severity. Additional or escalated findings remain blocking.
Publish as a GitHub prerelease with make_latest=false, digest-pinned per-flavor packages and known vulnerabilities disclosed.
Project owner reviews TASK-107 weekly and on changed exposure or vendor fixes. Remove the exception when fixed; expires January 30, 2027 without automatic renewal.
